| SC009 check authorized delegation and do not require equality | Same source/technical address holds for missing, expired, ambiguous and wrong-transport delegation. Actual resolver matches both legal and transport identities and the required current receiver role; source/SMTP equality cannot manufacture the explicitly configured delegation. Native or authentic legal mandate is not inferred from declared tenant-read ports. Existing qualified IMP02#525 proof remains scoped to its own actual import/source effects. |
| SC019 DGI received in P, requested by retailer K; examine data basis/rights/purpose | Actual beneficiary adapter requests exact beneficiary/actor/grant/version/billing-purpose/field/window and rejects wrong purpose, fields, source role/hash/version or current denial. Actual private RPC chain validates current grant/assignment/market-permission/data-window before provenance. Retained genuine V/VH reception/current-grant + DGI ESCO11 derivative cases prove accepted DGI source, separate beneficiary missions, current downstream-use/privacy/actor denial and unchanged origin/receipts. Unit billing-purpose ports and native synthetic-analysis purpose remain explicitly distinct. A billing-purpose fixture/grant does not create an invoice right. |
| SC019 examine delivery period and price model | Independently traced actual protected `gridex_store_billing_underlay`: owned supply/contract/date and locked price ID/version/hash/status/snapshot checks at 20260930175405 lines250–266, then qualified legal supply at267–268, occur BEFORE per-item DGI/source rejection269+. The suspected early DGI hold skipping supply/price is therefore refuted at this actual boundary. Reuse exact DB06 a5a9/#534 independent receipt5985218670:64TS/50 finite actual-function SQL cover price/supply/source refusals and complete protected basis; producers match415 and unchanged canonical/provenance assertions match excluding tags. |
| SC019 preserve source provenance; never rewrite DGI into DDQ-E66 | Actual derivative preserves original DGI role/application reference, sender/raw hash, source message, native contract version/hash, purpose and grant; selectively granted quality retains its exact original source. Wrong DDQ role and ungranted/private fields are denied. Retained native DGI case has exact source-hash/contract receipt and current replay with no second receipt insert; DB06 locks and preserves complete original underlay/items/binding separately from correction provenance. |
| SC019 never use data without rights | Current data-right denial propagates. Physical DGI remains unqualified for the supplier individual-billing basis, and reviewed actual gate/store tests leave zero finalized underlay/item/binding/correction effects even beside cached eligible/write-contract claims. The literal requires examination, not a successful invoice: scoped data/purpose examination plus actual supply/price/source holds satisfy it. No positive DGI invoice creation, authentic invoice/legal entitlement, source DDQ conversion, production send or invented mandate is asserted. |
